info.title: PetraERP API
info.description: PetraERP server API. Financial values are invariant decimal strings; UUIDs are strings; audit timestamps are UTC. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details with a stable 'code'.

get.summary: Reports that the API process is running, with its contract and product versions.
Admission-control state of financial writes: slots, queue length, wait percentiles and timeouts since the process started.
Lists active company-year workspaces the authenticated user is authorized to open.
Lists every permission code enforced by the server and the scope it is evaluated against.
Lists all companies and branches for scope assignment.
Pages the append-only security audit trail, newest first, with server-side filters.
Base currencies accepted for a new company: Arab League currencies plus USD and EUR.

post.summary: Creates a new legal company and provisions its initial fiscal year database.
Provisions a new independent annual database for an existing company.

get.summary: Analyzes monolithic source and prepares a partitioned annual migration plan.

post.summary: Executes or tests migration for a single company fiscal year into an independent database.
Signs in with a login name and password and opens a session.
Rotates the refresh token and issues a new access token. A reused refresh token ends the session.
Revokes the current session.
Revokes every session of the current user, on all devices.
Changes the current user's password, revokes all sessions and opens a new session.

get.summary: Returns the authenticated user's profile, session and granted permission codes.
Lists active companies the user is explicitly scoped to.
Lists active branches the user is explicitly scoped to inside an authorized company.
Lists users with server-side search and paging.

post.summary: Creates a user with a temporary password that must be changed at first sign-in.

put.summary: Enables or disables a user. Disabling revokes every session immediately.

post.summary: Sets a temporary password, requires a change at next sign-in and revokes every session.

put.summary: Replaces the user's explicit company and branch scope grants.

post.summary: Previews financial-year rollover including net income calculation, open items, and stock carryforward.
Executes multi-database fiscal year rollover, creates opening balances, carries forward subledgers, and activates target database.
Creates a native SQL Server backup with CHECKSUM and records it in central BackupCatalog.

get.summary: Lists registered database backups from BackupCatalog.

post.summary: Verifies an existing backup using RESTORE VERIFYONLY.
Restores backup into disposable test database and executes DBCC CHECKDB.
Validates Al-Ameen source schema and previews data counts.
Executes migration into an isolated target accounting database.

get.summary: Compares source and target accounting balances across 14 reconciliation checks.

post.summary: Finalizes and activates the migrated company-year workspace.

get.summary: Lists installed modules and whether each is running.

post.summary: Enables an installed module and starts it.
Stops a module without deleting its data.
Runs a command a module declares, with the caller's own permissions limited to those the module was approved for.
Posts an approved journal atomically. Replaying the same Idempotency-Key and body returns the same receipt.
Posts an approved reversal journal and marks the original as reversed in one transaction.

get.summary: Reads the cash-book voucher marker of a journal (404-free: null body when the journal is an ordinary one).

put.summary: Marks a draft journal as a cash-book voucher and names its cash account.

post.summary: Creates a new draft journal entry with lines.

get.summary: Gets journal details including lines and full audit trail.

put.summary: Revises an existing journal draft, replacing its lines.

post.summary: Validates a journal draft against chart of accounts, currency policies and balancing.
Approves a draft journal, preparing it for posting.
Returns an approved journal back to draft state for modifications.
Creates an unapproved reversal draft referencing a posted journal.

get.summary: Searches journals with state, date range and keyword filters.
Retrieves chart of accounts for line entry and lookup.
Retrieves cost centers for line allocation.

post.summary: Performs dry-run validation on draft journal lines before submitting.

get.summary: Paged company-wide account lifecycle history, retaining historical values after deletion.
Root-to-account path and a bounded page of immediate children in ordinal code order.
Reads the Al-Ameen account-card profile.

put.summary: Replaces the Al-Ameen account-card profile.

get.summary: Returns the company account hierarchy depth-first by code.
Searches accounts with paging.

post.summary: Deletes an unused leaf account (no children, no journal lines in any state) with a reason; used accounts must be deactivated.

get.summary: Returns the first, last, previous or next account in code order (one row; null past either end).
Returns the append-only audit of deleted accounts, newest first.
Paged company-wide cost-center history recorded since audit deployment; prior events are not reconstructed.

post.summary: Reopens a soft-closed or closed period. Requires the elevated Ledger.Periods.Reopen permission and a reason.

get.summary: Base and additional currencies enabled for the company. Exchange-rate history is not yet implemented.
Lists bank reconciliations, newest statement first.

post.summary: Starts the single open reconciliation of a book account.

get.summary: Open lines up to the statement date, cleared state and the live difference.

post.summary: Clears or unclears posted lines; all-or-nothing.
Completes a reconciliation whose difference is exactly zero.
Discards a draft reconciliation and releases its cleared lines.

get.summary: What the server durably recorded for an Idempotency-Key of the caller: use it after a lost response instead of posting again.
All catalogued reports (GL, FIN, FX, ARAP, CASH, INV, SALES, BUY, CC, SYSTEM) with delivery state; optional group and delivery filters.
Runs a catalogued analytical report (FX-04, FX-05, GL-08, FIN-03, FIN-04, FIN-08) over posted journal lines in the caller's branch scope.
Reads the warehouse accounting profile.

put.summary: Sets the warehouse accounting profile (validated: same branch, no cycle, postable accounts).

get.summary: Paged journal lines; posted journals by default, optional state filter.
Opening balance, paged posted lines with running balance, and closing balance for an account (control accounts include descendants).
Opening, period and ending balances per account with hierarchy roll-up and reconciled totals.
Lists document patterns for company.

post.summary: Creates a new document pattern with an initial draft revision.

get.summary: Gets active, runnable patterns available for the specified branch.
Gets the active published revision this branch runs, with the voucher settings resolved.
Searches the posting accounts the pattern's lines may use (its lookup restriction applied).
Gets document pattern details including active revision.

put.summary: Updates pattern metadata and branch grants.

post.summary: Creates a new draft revision for a pattern.
Publishes a pattern revision, making it the active immutable configuration.
Retires a pattern and marks its active revision retired.
Allocates and returns the next atomic document number according to pattern policy.

get.summary: Reads the number the pattern would issue next without reserving it; an estimate only, allocation stays server-side at save.
Lists parties (customers, suppliers, or both) for company.

post.summary: Creates a new party (customer, supplier, or both).

get.summary: Previews the heading and code of the account a party saved without one would get. Read-only.
Fast type-ahead lookup for parties with deterministic token-prefix matching.
Gets party details including contacts, addresses, and balance exposure.

put.summary: Updates party details with optimistic concurrency check.

post.summary: Deactivates a party preserving history and linked documents.
Reactivates a previously deactivated party.

get.summary: Gets party credit exposure, debits, credits, and current posted balance.
Lists inventory items with tokenized search and filtering.

post.summary: Creates a new inventory item with optional barcodes and price lists.

get.summary: Type-ahead item search by token prefix and barcode.
Gets item details including barcodes, prices, and conversions.

put.summary: Updates item details.

delete.summary: Deletes an item that has no stock movement or document line.

post.summary: Raises or lowers the general prices of active items by a percentage; preview first.
Deactivates an item preserving historical movements.
Reactivates a deactivated item.

get.summary: Calculates current stock and valuation for an item.
Lists all item groups for the company.

post.summary: Creates a new item group.

put.summary: Updates an item group.

get.summary: Gets item group details including child counts.

post.summary: Deactivates an item group.
Reactivates an item group.

get.summary: Gets accounting account mappings for an item or item group.

put.summary: Sets accounting account mappings for an item or item group.

get.summary: Gets effective account mappings for an item with inheritance traceability.
Lists units of measure.

post.summary: Creates a unit of measure.

put.summary: Updates a unit of measure.

post.summary: Adds a price row (list, unit, enabled currency, optional customer, pattern, quantity break and validity window).

delete.summary: Removes a price row. Documents keep the price they copied.

get.summary: Resolves the applicable price for a document line by the server priority; found=false when none applies.
Lists unit conversions.

post.summary: Creates a unit conversion ratio.

get.summary: Lists warehouses for the company or branch.

post.summary: Creates a new warehouse.

put.summary: Updates a warehouse.

get.summary: Lists stock ledger movements with date and warehouse filtering.

post.summary: Executes an atomic warehouse transfer with paired TransferOut and TransferIn movements.
Creates a stock adjustment draft with counted quantities and mandatory reason.
Approves an adjustment and posts difference movements to the stock ledger.
Posts an internal stock issue (e.g. diesel consumption) requiring a CostCenterId.

get.summary: Lists sales invoices for the company and branch with pagination and filters.

post.summary: Creates a new sales invoice draft.

get.summary: Returns the id of the first/previous/next/last invoice over the branch, optionally restricted by the list filters (customer, warehouse, status, dates, search). Without sortBy the order is ascending (date, created-at, id); with sortBy/sortDescending it is exactly the order the list shows (requested column, then date, created-at, id in the same direction).
Gets detailed sales invoice by ID including line items.

put.summary: Updates a draft sales invoice.

delete.summary: Deletes a never-approved draft sales invoice; posted invoices must be reversed instead.

post.summary: Saves a sales invoice and applies the company posting policy: draft, approve-only or approve-and-post.

put.summary: Updates a draft sales invoice and applies the company posting policy.

post.summary: Approves a draft sales invoice.
Atomically posts a sales invoice, generating sequence number, stock movements, and journal entry.
Reverses a posted sales invoice with linked reversal journal entry and stock return movements.
Posts a partial or full return of a posted invoice at original price and cost; returns the new return document.

get.summary: Resolves paged authoritative Sales links in the authorized company and branch.
Resolves paged authoritative Sales links in the authorized company and branch.
Resolves paged authoritative Sales links in the authorized company and branch.
Resolves paged authoritative Sales links in the authorized company and branch.
Resolves paged authoritative Sales links in the authorized company and branch.

post.summary: Approves a versioned draft voucher after reference, allocation and open-period checks.
Applies a posted party advance to invoices at frozen rates; a request-key replay preserves the same outcome.
Reverses a later settlement batch and releases its allocations while retaining immutable history.
Saves a voucher and applies the company posting policy: draft, keep-draft (approve-only) or post.

put.summary: Updates a draft voucher and applies the company posting policy.

get.summary: Lists receipt and payment vouchers in the branch.

post.summary: Creates a draft receipt or payment voucher.

get.summary: Gets a voucher with allocations and lines.

put.summary: Replaces a draft voucher; requires ExpectedVersion.

post.summary: Atomically numbers the voucher, rechecks allocations under lock and posts its journal; retrying the key replays.
Posts a linked reversal journal and releases the voucher's allocations.

get.summary: Lists posted customer or supplier invoices with derived open, partial or settled balances.
Posted credit invoices of a customer with authoritative paid and outstanding balances.
Lists commercial papers (cheques, promissory notes) with status and due date filters.

post.summary: Registers a new cheque or commercial paper.

get.summary: Gets a commercial paper by its identifier.

post.summary: Transitions the commercial paper lifecycle status (UnderCollection, Cleared, Bounced, Endorsed, Cancelled) and posts automated ledger entries.

get.summary: Retrieves overdue, due today, and due soon commercial paper alerts.
Lists purchase invoices and returns in the branch.

post.summary: Creates a draft purchase invoice.

get.summary: Gets a purchase invoice or return with lines.

put.summary: Replaces a draft purchase invoice; requires ExpectedVersion.

delete.summary: Deletes a never-posted draft purchase invoice.

post.summary: Saves a purchase invoice and applies the company posting policy: draft, approve-only or approve-and-post.

put.summary: Updates a draft purchase invoice and applies the company posting policy.

post.summary: Approves a draft purchase invoice.
Atomically numbers the invoice, receives stock at cost in base units and posts the supplier payable journal.
Reverses a posted purchase invoice with a linked reversal document, a mirrored journal and stock movements back at original cost.
Posts a return to the supplier at the original price and rate; returns the new return document.

get.summary: Revenue and expense accounts for a period from posted journal lines, with net income.
Asset, liability and equity balances at a date plus unclosed current earnings, with a balance check.
Customer or supplier statement in one currency: opening, documents with running balance, closing.
Receivable or payable aging by due date (invoice date + payment terms) with advances.
Posted sales less returns by pattern, customer or item in base currency, reconciled with GL revenue.
Posted purchases less returns by pattern, supplier or item with base quantities and stock cost.
Quantity and value per warehouse and item at a date, reconciled with the GL inventory accounts.
Opening, movements with origin documents and running quantity/value, closing for one item.
Accounts mapped as Cash or Bank by any document pattern.
Cash or bank statement: opening, posted lines with source documents and running balance, closing.
Permission-aware report sources, fields, implemented options and company fiscal years.

post.summary: Complete immutable financial snapshot; actual balances remain distinct from filtered display totals. Rejects more than 100,000 rows.

get.summary: Transaction currencies with posted party activity through the selected date.

post.summary: Discovers and classifies unposted documents without changing any state.
Persists a confirmed bulk posting request and posts its eligible documents one by one.

get.summary: Gets persisted totals and status for one batch.
Gets per-document results with pagination and status filters.

post.summary: Resumes a batch that was interrupted or report uncertain outcomes, reusing the same per-document keys.

get.summary: Base currency (with its lock state) and the currencies enabled for the company.

post.summary: Defines a currency when new (for example SYP or USD) and enables it for the company, with a reason.

put.summary: Changes the base currency only while the company has no journals, documents, stock, prices or rates; otherwise 422 currency.base_locked.
Edits the currency card (symbol, minor-unit names, decimal places 0..4, rounding mode) with a reason; audited with before/after.

get.summary: Exchange-rate register entries, newest effective date first.

post.summary: Appends a rate with effective date, source and reason. Entries are never edited; a correction is a new entry.
Registers a daily rate bulletin (1..50 currencies) atomically; every entry is append-only like a single rate.

get.summary: The register rate a document dated 'date' would use, or found=false; the base currency is always 1.
Branches of the company (active only unless includeInactive=true).

put.summary: Activates or deactivates a branch. A branch with active children or the last active branch cannot be deactivated.

post.summary: Repeats the copy of the branch card to the central database (safe to repeat).

put.summary: Maps a role to an account from a date; the previous mapping of that role ends the day before.

post.summary: Creates the branch's sub-accounts under the model branch's parents and maps them from the given date. Idempotent per (parent, branch code).

get.summary: Preview of sub-accounts the wizard would create for the branch, modelled on another branch. Creates nothing.
Dry run: whether a document may take the proposed number, with the documents or pending requests that collide. Writes nothing.

post.summary: The requester withdraws a pending request.
Applies the change. The approver must differ from the requester; the document keeps its id, type, status and journal link.

get.summary: Recomputes the audit hash chain of the company-year database.
Posted opening, period and closing balances per account and per branch; eliminate=true removes inter-branch clearing accounts from the consolidated column.
Compares the two companies' balances of the linked accounts at a date; Matched when this side + counterparty side = 0.

post.summary: Previews unrealized FX gains/losses across accounts with foreign currency balances as of date.
Read-only audit of posted foreign-currency lines whose own rate differs from the exchange-rate bulletin on their date.
Executes period-end FX revaluation and posts the balancing journal entry.
Creates a new draft opening balance batch.

get.summary: Lists opening balance batches for the current fiscal workspace.

post.summary: Validates an opening balance batch for balance, rates, and accounts.
Approves an opening balance batch for posting.
Posts an approved opening balance batch to the general ledger.
Reverses a posted opening balance batch.

get.summary: Gets an opening balance batch by id.
Lists open customer and supplier items.

post.summary: Creates an open item manually or for initial setup.

get.summary: Gets party balance summaries from open items.
Gets an open item by id.
Runs all 14 multi-layer reconciliation checks across GL, subledgers, inventory, and journals.
Exports full reconciliation report as structured JSON.
Exports full reconciliation findings as CSV.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code, for example 'auth.invalid_credentials'.

traceId.description: W3C trace identifier of the failed request.

correlationId.description: Value of the X-Correlation-Id response header; quote it when reporting a problem.

errors.description: Validation failures keyed by field name (400 responses only).
